assumptions.statement: The supplied overall boundary is a provisional rough polygon, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: Areas and partitions support concept comparison only; replace and regenerate when official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: Key-area polygons and centroids are provisional. The Dazhongsi placeholder was relocated to the station vicinity after an OSM and later official textual-extent cross-check, while remaining area-fitted rather than official.
assumptions.impact: Courts and detailed-area diagrams may still move and must not be read as precise station, parcel or road-redline interfaces.
assumptions.trigger: Receipt of official key-area polygons and access survey.

assumptions.statement: The offline map context is an OpenStreetMap/Overpass extract dated 2026-08-11, not a surveyed or statutory base map.
assumptions.impact: Roads, rail, water, parks, stations and campuses support orientation and design discussion only; they do not establish official redlines, parcels, blue lines or buildability.
assumptions.trigger: Receipt of cleared official base drawings and professional field verification.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership and municipal constraints are absent.
assumptions.impact: No statutory or approval claim is made; controls remain explicitly unknown.
assumptions.trigger: Planning-control, ownership, heritage, rail-safety and utility datasets.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are reversible programme markers, not a surveyed existing-building model.
assumptions.impact: Retain, adapt or remove decisions require building, heritage and carbon audits.

assumptions.statement: Routes express connections and public-space continuity, not engineered alignments or road redlines.
assumptions.impact: Lengths are diagrammatic; transport capacity and junction design are unresolved.
assumptions.trigger: Road/rail redlines, station interfaces, utilities and accessibility survey.

assumptions.statement: Every public AI device must carry an eight-field device passport and a human fallback.
assumptions.impact: Devices without evidence, responsibility, maintenance or retirement routes do not enter public deployment.

assumptions.statement: A district maker trust and multi-party maintenance partnerships are proposed but not yet constituted.
assumptions.impact: Delivery depends on governance, funding, data-protection and procurement agreements.
assumptions.trigger: Named lead entity, budget and signed partner charter.

assumptions.statement: Footfall, energy, repair, accessibility and public-trust baselines are not yet measured.
assumptions.impact: Scenario benefits are testable hypotheses, not confirmed performance.
assumptions.trigger: Published baseline protocol and seasonal measurement.

assumptions.statement: Phases are evidence gates—see, make, maintain or retire—not promised calendar dates.
assumptions.impact: Expansion pauses when public-interest, safety, accessibility or maintenance evidence fails.
assumptions.trigger: Independent gate review after each controlled pilot.
